upstream_expectation: the json-ld-1.0 framing result of "property CURIE conflict" (option.specVersion=json-ld-1.0): the property `dcterms:creator` compacted to the term `dcterms:creator` with the embedded node as its only value
our_expectation: the JSON-LD 1.1 result: IRI Compaction (JSON-LD 1.1 API §6.2, last-but-one step) raises `IRI confused with prefix`, because the input property is the absolute IRI `dcterms:creator` (the input context defines that term without a `dcterms` prefix), its scheme `dcterms` is a prefix term in the frame context, and it has no IRI authority
rationale: Version dispute of the same class as jsonld-compact #t0038. With the IRI-confused-with-prefix check disabled in 1.0 mode the output becomes "dcterms:creator": [node, null], and the fixture expects the node alone, so the fixture needs 1.0-era compaction as a whole; a 1.1 engine cannot give it without a separate 1.0 processing mode. Diagnosed 2026-10-10 by the Lean framing work (Harness/JsonLdFrameRun.lean, L4Factoidal/JSONLD/Frame.lean). The test runs; the runner counts it as local-override and reports a STALE override (a failure) if it starts to pass.
